title: "Recalculated data used" is incorrect; "Calculated data used" is the apparent intention.
symptom: AAPS reports 'recalculated data used' (warning triangle above BG) but this is confusing because it actually means it calculated new data because old data was out of date, not that it recalculated existing data.
cause: The original data was not in 5 min interval and AAPS approximated (recalculated) new data that matches 5 min interval. It has nothing to do with the age of data.
evidence_quote: No. It means that original data was not in 5 min interval and AAPS approximated (recalculated) new data that match  5 min interval.
